safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Misidentifying the patient’s antihypertensive as losartan when it may be lisinopril can corrupt the medication list and lead to downstream prescribing/monitoring errors (e.g., duplicative ACEi/ARB therapy, missed ACE-inhibitor cough/angioedema relevance, incorrect renal function/potassium monitoring expectations).
